text:
harper: quick heads-up  a couple of new users hit 401s after yesterday's key rotation when running the tutorial app locally.

dong: are they pulling keys from env vars or the CLI helper?

harper: env vars. some copied examples that still use REDWOOD_TOKEN; our latest README expects REDWOOD_API_KEY.

ria: parity gap. each SDK tolerates different names. we should standardize resolution order and surface a small deprecation warning for legacy names.

kevin: agreed. minimal plan: accept REDWOOD_API_KEY, then REDWOOD_KEY, then REDWOOD_TOKEN. if KEY/TOKEN used, log a one-line deprecation hint recommending REDWOOD_API_KEY.

ria: also improve the 401 text from /v1/authorize to suggest likely causes: "rotated key, project-scoped key, or wrong env var name" plus a link to the onboarding checklist.

dong: i'll add server-side tagging for rotation-suspected 401s when the presented key matches an old prefix pattern so support can find affected users.

kevin: small CLI QoL: `rw auth export` that prints export lines for bash/zsh/fish to rehydrate a session post-rotation. saves back-and-forth in support.

harper: can we include a brief triage snippet for support: check env var name, validate key scope (org vs project), try `rw auth export`, and if still failing, ask user to reissue an org-scoped key.

auth-bot: rotation-record: rotated by ops@acme at 2025-08-12T11:02:03Z; old_prefix=rw_oldx1; new_prefix=rw_newy2; impacted_clients=2

ria: PRs incoming for JS/Py SDK parity + richer 401 text. kevin, dong — want you to own sampleapp/CLI bits. link PRs to the support ticket when ready.

kevin: will do. tiny changes but should remove the main onboarding friction. :thumbsup:
